fact: Under the EU-funded PAIS project (UNICEF, WFP, IRC, NRC), each family in the target areas was given an electronic card with each child registered on it, which the school principal scans onto a tablet to take attendance, the data being uploaded to the Ministry of Education at least once a month where the connection allows; the primary school at Kénèkolo was to digitise its attendance in 2020.
title: Niani Diarra: Future President of Mali
